blocks.text: Join Us at Dance Institute Today

At Dance Institute, we are passionate about teaching dance to students aged 2 to adult. Our extensive curriculum includes Ballet, Tap, Lyrical, Contemporary, Pointe, Hip-Hop, Poms, Acro, Tumbling, and Jazz. We create a nurturing environment where students not only learn to dance but also develop confidence, dedication and self awareness.
Unlock your potential through our diverse offerings, designed to inspire creativity and artistic expression.
Our students gain valuable experiences through performances, building confidence and stage presence in a supportive setting.

"My daughter has grown up with a love of dance from a young age thanks to 5+ years with Dance Institute LLC and Ms. Michele. Dance Institute LLC has offered the perfect balance for our young dancer — great instruction and progressive growth with a relaxed, family-friendly, non-competitive atmosphere. I highly recommend Ms. Michele and Dance Institute"

"Dance with Miss Michele is the highlight of my (4 year old) daughter's week. This is her second year dancing and, not only does she continue to love it, but aslso she is learning all the basics at a young age.  Michele does a great job meeting her young students where they are and steadily teaching them skills poise , and positions while they smile and dance the hour away."
"Every class at Dance Institute is an opportunity to express myself and improve my skills. I love being part of this amazing dance family!"
At Dance Institute, we combine expert instruction with a warm, welcoming atmosphere, ensuring that every dancer, regardless of age or skill level, feels valued and inspired.
Our dedicated instructors are focused on each student's growth, emphasizing health and safety while fostering a love for dance.
We welcome your inquiries about classes, admissions, or any questions you may have. Reach out to us and let’s embark on this dance journey together.
